description: This file contains functions for checking, copying configurations, and upgrading firmware images on a specific platform. It includes procedures for partition management, image extraction, and device writing tailored for embedded device upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image partitions and compares them with existing device partitions, determining if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the device's partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by handling partition comparison, image writing, and device modification based on the provided image and options.
